description: rnews.rs lines 112-117: the cunbatch arm calls decompress_cunbatch() (which always returns Err) solely to propagate the error, then uses unreachable!(). This is a two-step where a direct return would be clearer: return Err(RnewsError::UnsupportedCompression(...)). The current pattern requires the reader to know that decompress_cunbatch always fails. The function exists for testability, but the call site could simply construct the error variant directly and not call it at all, or call it and use map_err to convert — the unreachable!() after a ?-operator is a smell. Alternatively, a unit-returning sentinel fn with a doc comment 'always Err, call for side-effects' is confusing. Simplest fix: return Err(RnewsError::UnsupportedCompression(...)) inline.
title: cunbatch arm calls always-Err fn then unreachable!()
